description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LoggerTrait' in the namespace 'Psr\Log', providing default implementations of various log level methods (emergency, alert, critical, error, warning, notice, info, debug) that delegate to a core 'log' method. It is used to include common logging functionality in classes that cannot extend 'AbstractLogger'.

methods.name: emergency
methods.description: Delegates the 'emergency' log level message to the 'log' method with 'LogLevel::EMERGENCY'.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Delegates the 'alert' log level message to the 'log' method with 'LogLevel::ALERT'.

methods.name: critical
methods.description: Delegates the 'critical' log level message to the 'log' method with 'LogLevel::CRITICAL'.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Delegates the 'error' log level message to the 'log' method with 'LogLevel::ERROR'.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Delegates the 'warning' log level message to the 'log' method with 'LogLevel::WARNING'.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Delegates the 'notice' log level message to the 'log' method with 'LogLevel::NOTICE'.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Delegates the 'info' log level message to the 'log' method with 'LogLevel::INFO'.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Delegates the 'debug' log level message to the 'log' method with 'LogLevel::DEBUG'.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by the class which uses this trait; it performs the actual logging.
